description: Eighteen steps, both walls covered in flash: inked and painted card pinned in ranks, the oldest at the bottom going to damp. Snakes, hearts, anchors, a lot of birds, a panel of back-of-shoulder pieces. Some carry a small red dot in the corner.

window.description: The stair window, four tall panes running the full height of the flight, with the flash sheets pinned across it edge to edge. It lets in almost nothing and it lets out a great deal, which is the correct way round for this building.
window.name: the flash window

name: No Regerts — The Stair
